scope: Compare/Focus presentation toggle; unchanged public source data, county geometry and backend.
behaviors: Compare is the default and restores all original quantity fills exactly.
Focus shows a gray map and a single orange selected county; its legend states that color means selection, not quantity.
No arbitrary county is selected when Focus opens without a county; a visible prompt explains the empty selection.
View survives reload/share URLs and invalid values fall back to Compare.
Keyboard county selection, year/measure changes, exact snapshot download and no horizontal overflow pass.
Unknown selected values remain hatched and Needs attention; missing geometry retains the table.
limits: Browser emulation is not a physical-device or exhaustive accessibility audit.
Existing validation cases are preserved; backend and Census facts are unchanged. Local runtime and deployed-site verification are recorded separately.
